office: the Department of Immigration and Emigration
note: The All-Countries Passport's processing fees and delivery times as the Department gives them; a minor (under 16) chooses three or ten years. The adult passport's validity isn't stated on the page, a lead. Fees at missions abroad are leads.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka, Issue of passport
sources.said: What are the delivery times for All-Countries Passport ? Normal Basis – 30 working days Urgent Basis – Same day What are the processing fees for All-Countries Passport ? Normal Basis - LKR. 10,000.00 Urgent Basis - LKR.20,000.00 ... Any person below 16 years of age is considered as a minor for this purpose. ... What are the processing fees for All-Countries Passport (below 16 years of age) ? Validity period for 3 years Normal Basis - LKR. 3,000.00 Urgent Basis - LKR. 9,000.00 Validity period for 10 years Normal Basis - LKR. 10,000.00 Urgent Basis - LKR. 20,000.00
